card.name: Dose after single or multiple
card.fires_on: The word dose or doses (or the piece 'ose' in 'multiple-dose') right after 'multiple' or 'single' in drug interaction study descriptions. Also fires weakly on a few other study-description words like '-month' and 'color'.

modes.label: Multiple-dose phrasing
modes.description: The word dose, doses or the piece ose after 'multiple' or 'multiple-d' in interaction studies.
modes.example: Multiple-d<<ose>> verapamil administration to healthy volunteers significantly

modes.label: Study duration or other study words
modes.description: Weaker firing on other words in study or solution descriptions, such as '-month' after a number.
